IC1: Provision of fully informed consent prior to study specific procedures.
IC2: Patients must be >= 19 years of age
IC3: RET fusion [OR] positive or FGFR2 fusion [OR]/other FGFR mutation Refractory solid tumor [OR] and/or specific sensitivity to Sunitinib by Avatar scan that has progressed following standard therapy or that has not responded to standard therapy or for which there is no standard therapy.
IC5: Have measurable or evaluated disease based on RECIST 1.1 as determined by investigator.
IC6: Absolute neutrophil count >= 1.5 x 109/L, Hemoglobin >= 9g/dL, Platelets>=100 x 109/L Bilirubin <= 1.5 x upper limit of normal AST [AND]/ALT [AND] <= 2.5 X upper limit of normal(5.0 x upper limit of normal, for subject with liver metastases) Creatinine<= 1.5 X UNL
IC7: Patients of child-bearing potential should be using adequate contraceptive measures should [NOT] not be breast feeding and must have a negative pregnancy test prior to start of dosing
